d: A mad scientist (Lionel Atwill) makes an electric man (Lon Chaney Jr.) who glows and must wear a rubber suit.
A mad scientist creates a monster when he transplants the brain of an executed murderer into the body of an ape.
A professor turns into a Neanderthal killer after injecting himself with the blood of an ancient fish.

A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes.
